data.name: IWantItHarder setup
data.author: dr.RazdalByte
data.description:
Ballance mod Based on Rev 1.6 Use AI:Skynet mod for max action.
30mm gimbal turret is more accurate and deals more damage. Adjusted bombs and missiles. 15-40mm guns are little more accurate now.
20mm Autocannons are reworked, less accurate, makes you trade altitude for munition and damage, ineffective against BER. Low planes, ships and vehicle lights. Lights are now more like a hint rather than target. Low altitude, CRR Flare and LGM illumination are your friends now during nighttime or heavy weather. Forces you to close the distance to spot targets visually, which means you are now have to coordinate your efforts.
Use MULs to assist PTR and RZR.
